topics.label: Course introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the cancer biology lecture series, its overarching themes, and the specific learning outcomes for the session.

topics.label: Biological basis of cancer in genetic changes and tissue architecture
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain cancer as a disease arising from accumulated genetic alterations that disrupt normal cellular differentiation and three-dimensional tissue architecture, alongside experimental models used to study these cellular behaviors.

topics.label: Invasion, metastasis, and the spectrum from benign to malignant tumours
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the pathological characteristics distinguishing benign from malignant tumors, detailing the mechanics of tissue invasion, routes of metastatic dissemination, and the stepwise histological progression from precursor lesions.

topics.label: Tumour classification and nomenclature conventions
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic defines the standard naming rules and suffix conventions used to classify benign and malignant tumors according to their tissue of origin, highlighting notable clinical exceptions.

topics.label: Pathophysiological causes of cancer morbidity and mortality
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the anatomical and systemic mechanisms by which primary tumor expansion and widespread metastatic colonization cause severe clinical complications and patient death.

topics.label: Epidemiological and comparative incidence of cancer across species
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the relative prevalence of different tumor types across human demographics and examine comparative oncology data demonstrating cancer as a fundamental vulnerability of multicellular organisms.

topics.label: Cancer detection strategies and organ-specific screening modalities
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics analyze the clinical rationale, histological diagnostic criteria, and practical limitations of population-based screening programs across diverse cancer types.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and practical reminders
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the concluding framing for the lecture, summarizing the session goals and reminding students about upcoming practicals.
